## Documentation problem

**Where** (page URL / file path / section heading):

**What is wrong** (incorrect, outdated, broken link, unclear…):

**What it should say** (if known):

## Type

- [ ] Incorrect information (contradicts repository evidence)
- [ ] Outdated (code moved on, docs did not)
- [ ] Broken link / navigation
- [ ] Translation issue (wrong or missing translation — name the language)
- [ ] RTL layout issue (Persian/Arabic)
- [ ] Site build / visual defect

## Evidence

If the documentation contradicts the repository, link the code, test, or
contract that proves it. Nexus-Docs treats the repository as the source of
truth — status labels are evidence-graded.
